messages:
Kai: hey! day 2 onboarding q: I made a short "first-week checklist" in Notion. Want the eng team to be able to tick items, but keep a small 'lead notes' section locked. Best spot & perms?
Maya (DevEx): welcome Kai :wave: put the doc under Docs > eng > <team-name> so team group perms apply. Invite <team>@redwood.com as Can edit for the whole doc. For the 'lead notes' section you can add a sub-page and set that sub-page to Can view or comment for the team and Can edit for <team>-leads@.
Kai: ah nice, sub-page per section. Will that preserve the check history if people tick boxes?
Olivia: checkboxes are per-page so history stays if you transfer the page. If you need auditability for who checked what we recommend creating a simple checklist task table (with a "completed_by" person prop) instead of relying on native checkbox history.
Kai: ok that sounds better. Where do canonical onboarding templates live if I want others to copy this?
Maya (DevEx): Templates live in Docs > Templates > Team templates. To suggest yours, duplicate it, move duplicate to Templates > Drafts, set page prop `template_status=candidate` and open a PR in the templates tracker (link on the Templates page).
Kai: I tried moving but Notion says "You don't have permission to move this page" (page id: 9f8e7d). Can Docs Ops transfer and keep comments?
docs-ops-bot: Ticket DOC-1305 created: "Transfer: Kai first-week checklist (9f8e7d) -> Docs > eng > <team-name>". Assignee: Docs Ops. https://tickets.redwood.com/DOC-1305
Maya (DevEx): quick tips: (1) avoid pasting secrets 1 use vault links like `vault://teams/<team>/onboard-creds`; (2) add a short header with `audience: new-hires`, `owner: <team>` so discoverability improves; (3) prefix template names with `tpl-` when promoting.
Kai: perfect. One more tiny ask: can we have a small automation to @-assign a follow-up to the new hire after they check "setup complete"?
Olivia: Notion doesn't do org-level automation by default. Options: (A) use a Notion integration + lightweight webhook that listens for checkbox change and posts an assignment in Slack, (B) just add a simple tasks database row and ask people to manually claim. If you want option A, open a Docs Ops ticket to provision a read-only integration token and infra can wire the webhook.
Kai: I'll start with a manual task row and if people like it we'll request the integration. Thanks all, closing the loop :raised_hands:
